# Superseded corpus claims (#7624) — DO NOT EDIT TO MAKE A TEST PASS

Verbatim sentences that the published legal corpus carried before the 2026-08-20
reconciliation to Art. 30 PA-7. Each is quoted here so `legal-doc-consistency.test.ts`
can prove every sentinel in its FORBIDDEN array once matched real prose — a sentinel that
matches nothing is dead on arrival, and a cardinality floor cannot tell the two apart.

Extracted from the pre-correction corpus. This file is a historical record: it is the one
place in the repo where these sentences are allowed to appear, and it is excluded from the
corpus sweep for that reason. Do not reword it to fix a failing test — a failure here means
a sentinel no longer corresponds to anything that was ever published.
